_doc: Remote screen on the Plus profile over Wi-Fi with the simulated hub's browser.session (generated pages). Targets: architecture v1.0 §9.5 (estimates).

hub.remote.sessions.why: the AI opened one remote screen

remote.updates.why: the first page and one update per tap were shown

remote.tap_feedback_visible_ms.p95.why: tap -> local feedback visible; ~250 ms, up to ~375 ms when the panel is still busy or powering up (one refresh at a time)

remote.tap_to_update_visible_ms.p95.why: tap -> a whole new page visible (Wi-Fi). Measured ~1.47 s, up to ~1.8 s when the panel also does a full clean refresh: the panel finishes the tap feedback, powers up and drives the full page in GL16, the touched spot put back in the same refresh; the 0.4-0.8 s estimate holds for partial changes (detailed design §13)

remote.feedback_restored.why: the touched spot goes back with each update

hub.remote.update_bytes.max.why: a full text page fits in 60 KB (estimate 20-60 KB)
